get_dataset: get a tensorflow dataset by name and split for single or multi label classification
get_single_label_dataset: get a single label TFDS dataset like cifar10 or mnist with classification metadata
get_multi_label_dataset: get a multi label TFDS dataset like celeb_a or voc with multi label metadata
to_minibatch_single_label: convert TFDS data to a minibatch with image and single label fields
to_minibatch_multi_label: convert TFDS data to a minibatch with image and one hot multi label fields
